Patch 0.5.5 · Forbidden Rites league · checked Oct 12, 2026

Fracturing Orb Farm

  • 78 Chaos orb, about 7.5 Div to sell
  • 82 Chaos to buy
  • 49 Exalted Sacred Bloom
  • 10.27 Chaos per Div

Prices follow demand in the current season and the economy keeps moving. These are the Oct 12 numbers, late in the season after the economy reset.

Tier 1 · League starter

Pocket Change

Your first maps, your first currency. It costs a few Chaos.

1 · Waystones · 3 examples

Filter the mods that kill your build out with your regex.

How the farm worksThe loop and where orbs come from

The loop

1 · Find the Corrupted Nexus

Corrupted maps show a red icon on the Atlas. The red tower in the middle is the Corrupted Nexus. FROM EXPERIENCE

2 · Cleanse it

Beat the Nexus boss and the area turns Cleansed (white crystal maps). Every corrupted node turns into a Cleansed node. Failed Nexus maps can be retried since 0.5.5. VERIFIED

3 · Run the Cleansed maps

Full clear each one and kill every rare and unique. Cleansed monsters are what drop Fracturing Orbs. Area level 75+ is the reported minimum, which is T11 and up. REPORTED

4 · Juice before you enter

Tablets, map rolls and Sacred Bloom wisps. This is the only step the three setups change.

Where the orbs come from

Cleansed monsters

The main source. Kill every rare: one creator got two orbs from a single rare. REPORTED

The Immured Fury

A unique Cleansed monster that always drops an orb. FROM EXPERIENCE

Summoning circle bosses

5% each, only with an extra monster modifier, only in Cleansed areas. About 4 circles per map is roughly 0.2 orbs per map (estimate). VERIFIED

This setup in fullSet 1 · Pocket Change with every line explained

Tablet

1 tablet, any type

The mod to look for: Map has 1 additional random Modifier. Ignore the other lines on it. REPORTED

Can't find that mod? Use number of Rare Monsters

Put it on every tablet you buy. More rares means more Cleansed monsters that can drop an orb.

Buy the cheapest type

In Oct 4–5 listings, a Breach tablet with that mod was 4 Chaos and a Delirium tablet was 1 Divine. Search again before you buy. A tablet has 10 uses, so divide the price by 10. VERIFIED

Map rolls (minimum)

Rare waystone with 6 mods

Alchemy, then Exalt until it is full. No omens needed to roll it. REPORTED

Area level 75+

Check each map's area level before you commit. T15 maps are level 79 and T16 are 80, one level less per tier down, so level 75 is T11. Irradiated adds 1 more. FROM EXPERIENCE

Skip map mods you cannot survive

Research your build first, then filter out the mods that kill you with your own regex. For the farm, how many mods a map has matters more than which ones. REPORTED

Master, Atlas, run

You only need one Cleansed node

Clear the Corrupted Nexus, the red tower in the middle. Once it is cleansed, every corrupted node turns Cleansed. How to reach it is in the section above. FROM EXPERIENCE

Any master you already have

Hilda is better (see Hopium) but you do not need her yet.

Use a Sacred Bloom if you can get one

Tested in game on 0.5.5: it works. About 49 Exalted, under 1 Chaos, and Ritual can reward them. They only exist in Forbidden Rites. VERIFIED

Full clear, and look for The Immured Fury

Guaranteed orb. FROM EXPERIENCE

What to expect

No creator tested this tier

There is no number to quote. Expect fewer orbs than the juiced setups.

Mapping mechanicsAzmeri Spirits, Summoning Circles, Essence, Ritual, Delirium and more

Tap a mechanic. Red = never skip it, blue = worth doing on your way, green = optional. Tagged CHECK means the 0.5.5 details are not confirmed yet.

Azmeri Spirits (Wildwood wisps)Four colors. Take them before you leave the Wildwood.

Tap a color to see what it does. The order Sacred, Golden, Purple, Blue is the order you take them in.

What it does

More item rarity, a chance for rare packs to include Map Bosses, a chance for rares to roll extra modifiers, and a chance for normal monsters to become Magic. REPORTED

What to do

Take every one you see. Likely: more rares and more bosses means more monsters that can drop an orb.

What it does

A chance for monsters to get additional modifiers. REPORTED

What to do

Take it after the Sacred ones.

Name check

The guide I could read calls this one Yellow (Vivid). Confirm it is the one you see as Golden. CHECK

What it does

More item rarity on what drops. The guide calls it Wild. REPORTED

What to do

Take it if it is on your path. Do not detour for it.

What it does

A chance for monsters to be upgraded to Magic. The guide calls it Primal. REPORTED

What to do

Lowest priority. Grab it on the way past.

All four empower the monsters they land on

They take less damage and hit harder. When you leave the Wildwood, the wisps you collected are spread across the monsters in the map. REPORTED

Follow the trails

Wisps form trails to the four points of interest at the tips of the diamond. No trail? Run diagonally through the dark to the next one. REPORTED

Small white wisps restore your light

Light is the limit on how long you can explore. Big white wisps reveal a wide area for free. REPORTED

Missed some? Go back

Once the exit portal appears you can still go back for wisps. REPORTED

The Immured FuryUnique monster that always drops an orb.

What it is

A unique Cleansed monster. It is the one guaranteed orb in a map that has it. FROM EXPERIENCE

What to do when you find it

Type "Immured" in the Atlas search box to find maps that have it. Kill it, always.

Summoning CirclesA ring of stones that calls a boss.

What it is

Activating the circle summons a boss. In Cleansed areas, a circle boss has a 5% chance to drop an orb, and only if it has an extra monster modifier. VERIFIED

What to do when you find it

With several circles, finish the circle first, then activate the stones one at a time. Do not build around them: about 4 circles in a map is roughly 0.2 orbs.

RitualAltar circle. Kill what spawns inside.

What it is

An altar with a ring around it. Monsters spawn when you start it, and you spend what they give you at the altar. REPORTED

What to do when you find it

Kill the Cleansed monsters inside the circle. Orbs can still drop after the ritual ends.

DeliriumMirror that fills the map with fog.

What it is

Interact with the mirror and fog spreads. Monsters in it are tougher and pay more. REPORTED

What to do when you find it

Kill every rare. Grab the checkpoints to find them. Finish the Delirium for splinters.

BreachA hand tears open and monsters pour out.

What it is

A breach opens in the ground and monsters flood out until it closes. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Open it, kill everything that spills out, then move on.

Essence CrystalsMonsters trapped in crystals.

What it is

Crystal-encased monsters around the map. Free one and it comes out as a rare with essence mods. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Click the crystal, kill what comes out. It counts as a rare, so it is another chance at an orb.

Rogue ExilesA named rare exile with real gear.

What it is

A hostile exile wandering the map with its own skills. It drops gear and currency. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Kill it if your build can take it. A death costs more than the drop.

ShrinesClick for a short buff.

What it is

A shrine gives you a temporary buff when you click it. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Save it for a big pack or the boss. The buff runs out.

StrongboxesLocked chest with guards.

What it is

A chest guarded by monsters. Loot, not orbs. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Open it if it is on your path. Do not detour for it.

Atlas and mastersHilda, Doryani and the nodes that matter

Master pick: Hilda's Hunting

8% more effect on tablet mods per tablet type

Three different tablet types gives 24%. VERIFIED

Overlord's Domain: 45% chance to add twice as much content

Overlord's Influence too. VERIFIED

25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses

Overlord's Domain needs a Powerful Map Boss, so this means more circles. VERIFIED

15% more rare monsters, and 25% more chance of monster modifiers on them

VERIFIED

The safe pick: Doryani's Science

Safe setup: an additional Revival, up to 6

Your maps get extra revivals. Use it if the content is too hard. VERIFIED

Possibly better setup: Map Areas are Irradiated

The node is Disengaged Safeties, in place of the revival. Irradiated gives the area +1 to Monster Level. You think it may be better. Irradiation only works once, so an Irradiated tablet would add only its own mods. VERIFIED

Per explicit modifier on the map: 2% monster effectiveness, 3% more chance of rare monster modifiers, 1% item rarity

VERIFIED

Waystones have 25% more effect of prefix modifiers or suffix modifiers when opening maps

Also: magic packs have a 35% chance of an extra modifier. VERIFIED

Atlas nodes

A Cleansed node

You only need one to run the mechanic. Clear the Corrupted Nexus and every corrupted node turns Cleansed. FROM EXPERIENCE

From Distances Untold

5% orb chance on summoning circle bosses with an extra modifier, in Cleansed areas. Also gives those bosses a 25% chance of an extra modifier. Needs level 75+ and the Burning Monolith done. VERIFIED

Challenging Foe, Overheard Summons

Circle bosses get a 25% chance of an extra modifier. Circles get a 10% chance to summon an extra boss. VERIFIED

Overlord's Domain: pick "A Summoning Circle"

Adds that content to areas with Powerful Map Bosses. Level 70+ areas. Other options: an Essence or a Rogue Exile. Reallocate any time. VERIFIED

The Chosen Path: pick "Summoning Circles"

100% increased chance of the content type you pick. Level 70+ areas. Reallocate any time. VERIFIED

Not sure you have a node? Search for it

Type the name in the Atlas search box and the game highlights matching maps. It only works on revealed maps. FROM EXPERIENCE

Pack size, rare monsters, rarity, effectiveness

Two creators say any of them are fine. Take what you can reach.

Do not build around circles

Even with both nodes, each circle boss is 5%. 4 circles is about 0.2 orbs per map. Treat them as a bonus.

Getting a Cleansed nodeCorrupted Nexus, shortest path, Grand Project

Clear the Corrupted Nexus

It is the red tower in the middle of the Atlas. Once it is cleansed, every corrupted node turns into a Cleansed node. FROM EXPERIENCE

Take the shortest path to the tower

Count the maps between you and it before you commit. FROM EXPERIENCE

Or use a Grand Project tablet

It can only be applied to Precursor Tower maps. Completing the tower makes all nearby maps accessible, so you can pick any node in range and run it without pathing over. A tower covers roughly 12 to 18 maps. Asking price on Oct 12: about 400 Vaal Orbs, roughly 57 Chaos (5.5 Div) for 1 use. REPORTED

Atop the World node

33% increased Precursor Tower reveal radius, so more maps fall in range. Also 10% more waystones from map bosses. Level 70+ areas. VERIFIED

Run orderThe same loop on every map

The same loop for every map. A Sacred Bloom costs under 1 Chaos, so do steps 2 and 3 in all three tiers.

  1. Slot tablets, check the map

    Confirm mod count and area level before you open the portal.

  2. Apply Sacred Bloom to the Cleansed map

    It adds a Viridian Wildwood to the map and all maps connected to it. VERIFIED

  3. Wildwood portal near the entrance: collect wisps

    Sacred first, then Golden, Purple, Blue. Keep moving and take as many as you can. REPORTED

  4. Leave the Wildwood and clear the map

    Monsters in the map are boosted by the wisps you took. VERIFIED

  5. Find and kill every rare

    Use the Delirium mirror and checkpoints to locate them. Rares in Cleansed packs can drop more than one orb. REPORTED

  6. Ritual and circles

    Kill the Cleansed monsters in the Ritual circle. With summoning circles, finish the circle first, then activate stones one at a time. REPORTED

  7. Boss, then finish Delirium

    Splinters are a bonus, not the point.

  8. Log it and go to the next map

    Orbs, minutes, deaths, other loot. Use the test log below.

Prices and break-evenWhat a map has to return to pay for itself

Break-even: what a map returns in orbs

At 78 Chaos per orb (about 7.5 Div, at the market ratio of 10.27 Chaos per Div). If your tablets and map cost more per map than the row you hit, you are gambling. VERIFIED

Orbs per mapReturnIn Div
0.25 (low end reported)about 20 Chaos2 Div
0.5about 39 Chaos3.8 Div
0.9 (high end reported)about 70 Chaos6.8 Div
1about 78 Chaos7.6 Div
3 (best single map reported)about 235 Chaos23 Div

Cost per map = tablet prices ÷ 10 (10 uses each) + the map price + one Sacred Bloom (under 1 Chaos).

Official 0.5.5 patch notes thread

Sacred Bloom, Doryani and Viridian Wildwood changes.

poe2db Summoning Circle page

From Distances Untold, Challenging Foe, Overheard Summons.

Game, Oct 12

Currency Exchange prices (Fracturing Orb 78 Chaos, Sacred Bloom 49 Exalted, 1 Chaos = 68 Exalted, 1 Div = 10.27 Chaos market ratio, orb 1:8 Div to buy and about 1:7.5 to sell), the Overlord's Domain, Chosen Path, Hilda's Hunting and Doryani's Science panels, Sacred Bloom wisps working, item rarity 95% plus 15% from the charm. Also the Grand Project Irradiated Tablet trade listings (asking about 400 Vaal Orbs), the Atop the World node, and Vaal Orb rates (1 Chaos = 7 Vaal, 1 Div = 72.5 Vaal).

poe2db Ritual page

Ritual, Delirium and Breach tablets have 10 uses, and their prefix and suffix mod pools.

Tested in game

A corruption can drop a waystone a tier, so buy the exact map on trade with your regex. A perfect map has 100% (the normal cap) and any extra line means a corruption added it. Tablets hold 2 prefixes and 2 suffixes. T15 is area level 79 and T16 is 80, one less per tier down, Irradiated adds 1, and Irradiation only works once. The Immured Fury always drops an orb.

Reported by creators (not tested)

Four videos

Kingpin (Doryani, older), Sicious (summoning circles), and two creators not named: Hilda with Overseer, Irradiated and Delirium, and the Sacred Bloom one with 9 orbs in 10 maps.

Vulkk guide, June 17

Hilda options. From before 0.5.5.

Grand Project map count

The 12 to 18 maps per tower comes from a community summary, not a test. Check the count on the tablet you buy.

Timesaver.gg

Old tablet costs. A seller site, so treat it as promotional.

Check in game

Orb price moves

Re-check the Currency Exchange before you run a set. Divine is confirmed at 10.27 Chaos as of Oct 12.

This setup in fullSet 2 · Hopium with every line explained

Tablets

2–3 tablets, all different types

Delirium + Ritual + Breach, or Overseer + Irradiated + Delirium. Three different types is what powers Hilda's tablet bonus. REPORTED

Mod 1: Map has 1–2 additional random Modifiers

Mandatory on every tablet. It adds modifiers to the whole map. Three of four creators say so. REPORTED

Mod 2: pack size or more Rare Monsters

Both are prefixes and work on most mechanics. Creators also use effectiveness. Skip the rarity lines unless a tablet is too expensive. REPORTED

Map rolls (minimum)

Rare T15–T16 waystone, 6 mods

Alchemy, then Exalt until full, or buy one on trade with your regex. REPORTED

+100% monster rarity, or pack size

One creator rolls his maps with one of these two. REPORTED

8 mods comes from a corruption, not a roll

A corruption can add a line or drop the tier. Do not corrupt your own. Save the bought 8-mod map for The Gambler. FROM EXPERIENCE

Master and Atlas

Hilda

8% more effect on tablet mods per tablet type, 24% with three types. Doryani is the safe swap if the content is too hard. VERIFIED

Pack size, rare monsters, rarity, effectiveness nodes

Any of them are fine. Take what you can reach.

Before you enter and while you run

Use Sacred Bloom on the Cleansed map

It also affects connected maps. One video had 4 maps get Wildwood. REPORTED

Take the Wildwood portal near the entrance and grab wisps

Priority: Sacred, Golden, Purple, Blue. After you leave, monsters in the map are boosted by your wisps. VERIFIED

The Wildwood portal still works

Tested in game on 0.5.5, even though the patch notes say the Viridian Wildwood unique map was disabled. VERIFIED

Delirium mirror: kill every rare

Grab checkpoints to find them. Finish the Delirium for splinters. REPORTED

Ritual: kill the Cleansed monsters in the circle

Orbs can still drop after the ritual ends. REPORTED

Cost

Hilda-run creator

About 3 Div for a tablet with only the extra map mods, 12–14 Div when you add effectiveness on top. REPORTED

A tablet has 10 uses

Divide its price by 10 for your cost per map. VERIFIED

    Orbs, minutes, deaths, other loot. Use the test log below.

How the farm worksThe loop and where orbs come from

The loop

1 · Find the Corrupted Nexus

Corrupted maps show a red icon on the Atlas. The red tower in the middle is the Corrupted Nexus. FROM EXPERIENCE

2 · Cleanse it

Beat the Nexus boss and the area turns Cleansed (white crystal maps). Every corrupted node turns into a Cleansed node. Failed Nexus maps can be retried since 0.5.5. VERIFIED

3 · Run the Cleansed maps

Full clear each one and kill every rare and unique. Cleansed monsters are what drop Fracturing Orbs. Area level 75+ is the reported minimum, which is T11 and up. REPORTED

4 · Juice before you enter

Tablets, map rolls and Sacred Bloom wisps. This is the only step the three setups change.

Where the orbs come from

Cleansed monsters

The main source. Kill every rare: one creator got two orbs from a single rare. REPORTED

The Immured Fury

A unique Cleansed monster that always drops an orb. FROM EXPERIENCE

Summoning circle bosses

5% each, only with an extra monster modifier, only in Cleansed areas. About 4 circles per map is roughly 0.2 orbs per map (estimate). VERIFIED

This setup in fullSet 3 · The Gambler with every line explained

Tablets

3 tablets, 3 different types

Setup A: Delirium + Ritual + Breach. Swap B: Overseer + Irradiated + Delirium, which adds summoning circles. Test A first. REPORTED

Every tablet: 2 prefixes + 2 suffixes, all high rolls

Prefixes: pack size (5–7%) and number of Rare Monsters (25–35%). Suffixes: Map has 1–2 additional random Modifiers (roll the 2), plus one more of your pick. A tablet only holds 2 prefixes, so effectiveness and both rarity lines stay off. FROM EXPERIENCE

Skip monster rarity and item rarity on tablets

Both are prefixes. Take pack size and Rare Monsters over them unless you have a better reason. FROM EXPERIENCE

A tablet has 10 uses

Ritual, Delirium and Breach tablets all show 10 uses on poe2db, and they share the same prefix list and the same extra-modifier suffix. VERIFIED

Swap B only: summoning circle lines

"Map contains 1 additional Summoning Circle" is a prefix. "Unique monsters have 1 additional Rare Modifier" is a suffix. They take slots from pack size and Rare Monsters, which is why B is a swap and not the default. VERIFIED

Do not price by looks

A perfect tablet that costs more than the map returns is the gamble. Check the break-even table first.

Map rolls (best)

Buy the map on trade, do not roll it

Use your waystone regex and search for the exact map you want. Crafting your own is its own video. FROM EXPERIENCE

Perfect map: 100% monster rarity or effectiveness, plus extra lines on top

100% is the cap on a normal waystone with no other stats. Extra pack size, monster rarity or effectiveness above that means a corruption added it, so it is easy to search for. FROM EXPERIENCE

Tier: T15–T16, check the tier you actually bought

A corruption can drop a map a tier (T15 to T14). People sell those and roll again, so trade is full of them. T15 is level 79 and T16 is 80 (81 with Irradiated). FROM EXPERIENCE

8 mods: the corruption added a line

Do not corrupt your own. Buy one that already came out ahead.

Skip anything you cannot survive

A death costs more than a missing mod. Keep using your regex to filter.

Master and Atlas

Hilda with three different tablet types

24% more effect on tablet mods. Her 45% chance of twice the content on Overlord's Domain feeds the circle nodes. VERIFIED

Overlord's Domain and The Chosen Path: both on Summoning Circles

Both apply to level 70+ areas and can be reallocated any time. More circles per map, but each circle boss is still only 5%. VERIFIED

From Distances Untold, Challenging Foe, Overheard Summons

Worth taking, not worth chasing. VERIFIED

Doryani: the safe pick

He gives an additional Revival, up to 6. Switch to him if the content is too hard. VERIFIED

Before you enter and while you run

Sacred Bloom, then Wildwood wisps

Tested in game on 0.5.5: it works. Portal near the entrance, wisps in order Sacred, Golden, Purple, Blue. A bloom costs about 49 Exalted today. VERIFIED

Kill every rare, then the boss, then finish Delirium

Rares sit inside Cleansed packs and can drop more than one orb. REPORTED

Swap B: finish the circle first

With several circles, do not touch the activation stones until the circle is done. Then activate one at a time. REPORTED

What creators reported

Yields, unproven

9 orbs in 10 maps on a setup like this, 28 orbs in about a day and a half, up to 3 in one map, and 5 to 6 per 20 maps on summoning circles alone. REPORTED

Older price range

Older videos priced the orb at 8 to 13+ Div. On Oct 12 it was about 7.5 Div to sell, a bit under that range. VERIFIED

Mapping mechanicsAzmeri Spirits, Summoning Circles, Essence, Ritual, Delirium and more

Tap a mechanic. Red = never skip it, blue = worth doing on your way, green = optional. Tagged CHECK means the 0.5.5 details are not confirmed yet.

Azmeri Spirits (Wildwood wisps)Four colors. Take them before you leave the Wildwood.

Tap a color to see what it does. The order Sacred, Golden, Purple, Blue is the order you take them in.

What it does

More item rarity, a chance for rare packs to include Map Bosses, a chance for rares to roll extra modifiers, and a chance for normal monsters to become Magic. REPORTED

What to do

Take every one you see. Likely: more rares and more bosses means more monsters that can drop an orb.

What it does

A chance for monsters to get additional modifiers. REPORTED

What to do

Take it after the Sacred ones.

Name check

The guide I could read calls this one Yellow (Vivid). Confirm it is the one you see as Golden. CHECK

What it does

More item rarity on what drops. The guide calls it Wild. REPORTED

What to do

Take it if it is on your path. Do not detour for it.

What it does

A chance for monsters to be upgraded to Magic. The guide calls it Primal. REPORTED

What to do

Lowest priority. Grab it on the way past.

All four empower the monsters they land on

They take less damage and hit harder. When you leave the Wildwood, the wisps you collected are spread across the monsters in the map. REPORTED

Follow the trails

Wisps form trails to the four points of interest at the tips of the diamond. No trail? Run diagonally through the dark to the next one. REPORTED

Small white wisps restore your light

Light is the limit on how long you can explore. Big white wisps reveal a wide area for free. REPORTED

Missed some? Go back

Once the exit portal appears you can still go back for wisps. REPORTED

The Immured FuryUnique monster that always drops an orb.

What it is

A unique Cleansed monster. It is the one guaranteed orb in a map that has it. FROM EXPERIENCE

What to do when you find it

Type "Immured" in the Atlas search box to find maps that have it. Kill it, always.

Summoning CirclesA ring of stones that calls a boss.

What it is

Activating the circle summons a boss. In Cleansed areas, a circle boss has a 5% chance to drop an orb, and only if it has an extra monster modifier. VERIFIED

What to do when you find it

With several circles, finish the circle first, then activate the stones one at a time. Do not build around them: about 4 circles in a map is roughly 0.2 orbs.

RitualAltar circle. Kill what spawns inside.

What it is

An altar with a ring around it. Monsters spawn when you start it, and you spend what they give you at the altar. REPORTED

What to do when you find it

Kill the Cleansed monsters inside the circle. Orbs can still drop after the ritual ends.

DeliriumMirror that fills the map with fog.

What it is

Interact with the mirror and fog spreads. Monsters in it are tougher and pay more. REPORTED

What to do when you find it

Kill every rare. Grab the checkpoints to find them. Finish the Delirium for splinters.

BreachA hand tears open and monsters pour out.

What it is

A breach opens in the ground and monsters flood out until it closes. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Open it, kill everything that spills out, then move on.

Essence CrystalsMonsters trapped in crystals.

What it is

Crystal-encased monsters around the map. Free one and it comes out as a rare with essence mods. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Click the crystal, kill what comes out. It counts as a rare, so it is another chance at an orb.

Rogue ExilesA named rare exile with real gear.

What it is

A hostile exile wandering the map with its own skills. It drops gear and currency. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Kill it if your build can take it. A death costs more than the drop.

ShrinesClick for a short buff.

What it is

A shrine gives you a temporary buff when you click it. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Save it for a big pack or the boss. The buff runs out.

StrongboxesLocked chest with guards.

What it is

A chest guarded by monsters. Loot, not orbs. CHECK

What to do when you find it

Open it if it is on your path. Do not detour for it.

Atlas and mastersHilda, Doryani and the nodes that matter

Master pick: Hilda's Hunting

8% more effect on tablet mods per tablet type

Three different tablet types gives 24%. VERIFIED

Overlord's Domain: 45% chance to add twice as much content

Overlord's Influence too. VERIFIED

25% chance to upgrade Map Bosses to Powerful Map Bosses

Overlord's Domain needs a Powerful Map Boss, so this means more circles. VERIFIED

15% more rare monsters, and 25% more chance of monster modifiers on them

VERIFIED

The safe pick: Doryani's Science

Safe setup: an additional Revival, up to 6

Your maps get extra revivals. Use it if the content is too hard. VERIFIED

Possibly better setup: Map Areas are Irradiated

The node is Disengaged Safeties, in place of the revival. Irradiated gives the area +1 to Monster Level. You think it may be better. Irradiation only works once, so an Irradiated tablet would add only its own mods. VERIFIED

Per explicit modifier on the map: 2% monster effectiveness, 3% more chance of rare monster modifiers, 1% item rarity

VERIFIED

Waystones have 25% more effect of prefix modifiers or suffix modifiers when opening maps

Also: magic packs have a 35% chance of an extra modifier. VERIFIED

Atlas nodes

A Cleansed node

You only need one to run the mechanic. Clear the Corrupted Nexus and every corrupted node turns Cleansed. FROM EXPERIENCE

From Distances Untold

5% orb chance on summoning circle bosses with an extra modifier, in Cleansed areas. Also gives those bosses a 25% chance of an extra modifier. Needs level 75+ and the Burning Monolith done. VERIFIED

Challenging Foe, Overheard Summons

Circle bosses get a 25% chance of an extra modifier. Circles get a 10% chance to summon an extra boss. VERIFIED

Overlord's Domain: pick "A Summoning Circle"

Adds that content to areas with Powerful Map Bosses. Level 70+ areas. Other options: an Essence or a Rogue Exile. Reallocate any time. VERIFIED

The Chosen Path: pick "Summoning Circles"

100% increased chance of the content type you pick. Level 70+ areas. Reallocate any time. VERIFIED

Not sure you have a node? Search for it

Type the name in the Atlas search box and the game highlights matching maps. It only works on revealed maps. FROM EXPERIENCE

Pack size, rare monsters, rarity, effectiveness

Two creators say any of them are fine. Take what you can reach.

Do not build around circles

Even with both nodes, each circle boss is 5%. 4 circles is about 0.2 orbs per map. Treat them as a bonus.

Getting a Cleansed nodeCorrupted Nexus, shortest path, Grand Project

Clear the Corrupted Nexus

It is the red tower in the middle of the Atlas. Once it is cleansed, every corrupted node turns into a Cleansed node. FROM EXPERIENCE

Take the shortest path to the tower

Count the maps between you and it before you commit. FROM EXPERIENCE

Or use a Grand Project tablet

It can only be applied to Precursor Tower maps. Completing the tower makes all nearby maps accessible, so you can pick any node in range and run it without pathing over. A tower covers roughly 12 to 18 maps. Asking price on Oct 12: about 400 Vaal Orbs, roughly 57 Chaos (5.5 Div) for 1 use. REPORTED

Atop the World node

33% increased Precursor Tower reveal radius, so more maps fall in range. Also 10% more waystones from map bosses. Level 70+ areas. VERIFIED

Run orderThe same loop on every map

The same loop for every map. A Sacred Bloom costs under 1 Chaos, so do steps 2 and 3 in all three tiers.

  1. Slot tablets, check the map

    Confirm mod count and area level before you open the portal.

  2. Apply Sacred Bloom to the Cleansed map

    It adds a Viridian Wildwood to the map and all maps connected to it. VERIFIED

  3. Wildwood portal near the entrance: collect wisps

    Sacred first, then Golden, Purple, Blue. Keep moving and take as many as you can. REPORTED

  4. Leave the Wildwood and clear the map

    Monsters in the map are boosted by the wisps you took. VERIFIED

  5. Find and kill every rare

    Use the Delirium mirror and checkpoints to locate them. Rares in Cleansed packs can drop more than one orb. REPORTED

  6. Ritual and circles

    Kill the Cleansed monsters in the Ritual circle. With summoning circles, finish the circle first, then activate stones one at a time. REPORTED

  7. Boss, then finish Delirium

    Splinters are a bonus, not the point.

  8. Log it and go to the next map

    Orbs, minutes, deaths, other loot. Use the test log below.
